experiment_data.hypothesis: Demo count sensitivity v2 (Method B fixed): subsample 25 from 50 demos/task, rerun RSA (correct Method B) + probe on trained_image_mean. Tests inverted-U stability under reduced data.

metrics.conclusion_summary: Inverted-U highly stable under halved data. RSA profile r=0.97, peak L12 unchanged. Probe profile r=0.82, peak shifts L9→L11 but shape preserved.
